source_failures.issue: Twelve targeted search queries produced an anomalously narrow visible response, dominated by a CMS notices page; independent local reporting recall could not be confidently assessed from that index response.
source_failures.impact: Reduced confidence in independent national and territory candidate discovery. Some coverage recovered by direct publisher index checks.

coverage_notes.status_rationale: DEGRADED: CMS successfully verified first and five supplemental publisher pages accessed; 12 targeted discovery queries submitted but the search response surfaced essentially only the CMS listing, limiting independent recall. No newly supported qualifying event verified.
coverage_notes.limitations: No findings does not prove no healthcare access disruptions occurred. Indexing delay, non-exhaustive rural/territorial coverage and atypically narrow search-result presentation materially limit this run. Production collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.controls: Created only a private watch-ledger heartbeat; no editorial approval, publication, schedule alteration, or task disabling.
